content: I'm curious if anyone has a working config for neovim+lean plug-in on nixos?

are you looking for a nix version for lean config for neovim, lazy.nvim or something else?
i think you can take any neovim config with nix, and since lean-nvim is mostly the usual setup, you could copy that.

#Editors & UIs

I have not used nixos with the plugin in quite a few years, but you also might find https://github.com/Julian/lean.nvim/issues/465 useful, there's a config there that someone was using at the time -- though to my recollection the issue is that Lean itself does not have a maintained flake. I think there's a third party maintained one you might be able to find here in the Zulip if my memory serves, and then adding lean.nvim will likely be trivial on top.
